blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Flag carrier Philippine Airlines (PAL) will offer discounts on select business class and premium economy seats for the first time, ahead of the peak holiday travel season. PAL’s week-long sale, running from Oct. 19 to 25, will offer discounts of up to 60 percent for business class and premium economy seats on select domestic and international destinations.
